case_title: SHIRVANI VADJIHE J.( AKA FLORANCE) VS WELLS FARGO BANK

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $600.00 FILED BY SHIRVANI VADJIHE J.( AKA FLORANCE) AS TO DEFENDANT WELLS FARGO BANK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-23-1992 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
